names.note: Name page of days.pravoslavie.ru for this memory is «Феодосий (Беленький), иерей, сщмч.»; the grade and the rank are stripped and the surname kept, the day line itself giving only the forename. `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE.

death.note: The day line closes «(1938)», which is the whole of what the source gives; no year of birth anywhere.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 29 декабря ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Феодосия пресвитера (1938).»

attestations.note: THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGE ARE ALL THERE IS: no life page stands behind this entry. The line names one man and he is in this draft. A Cyrillic grep for «Беленький» over every `saint.json` returns nothing. The day page prints seven hymns — two for Mark the Gravedigger, two for the venerable Marcellus and three for the fourteen thousand infants — and none under this name.
